meta.title: ULIQ Presale | uLiquid Desk
meta.description: Review the two ULIQ presale rounds, connect a wallet, track purchases, and manage vesting.

hero.title: ULIQ Presale
hero.description: Two transparent rounds with wallet-based access, onchain settlement, and round-specific vesting.
hero.contractsPending: Contract addresses will be added later
hero.previewNotice: This is a non-transactional UI preview using the approved round parameters. Contract data, wallet verification, and purchases remain disabled until the separate onchain approval.
hero.unavailable: The public presale is not configured in this environment yet.

rounds.title: Presale rounds
rounds.description: Both rounds share one global listing timestamp but retain isolated caps, wallet limits, and vesting pools.
rounds.configurationMismatch: Contract configuration requires review. Purchases are disabled.

access.title: Wallet access
access.description: No Desk account is created. A free signature verifies this wallet for 24 hours.
access.connect: Connect a wallet in the header to continue.
access.wrongWallet: The connected wallet differs from the verified presale wallet. Verify it again to continue.
access.wrongNetwork: Switch to the configured Arbitrum network.
access.termsDescription: Review the dedicated Presale Terms, Terms of Use, Privacy Policy, and Crypto Risk Disclosure before buying.
access.termsCheckbox: I have read and accept the current ULIQ Presale Terms.
access.termsUnavailable: The approved Presale Terms have not been published. Purchases remain disabled.
access.previewUnavailable: Wallet verification and purchases will be enabled only after the reviewed contract configuration is available.
access.statement: Sign in to the ULIQ Presale. This signature is free and does not submit a transaction.

purchase.title: Buy in {round}
purchase.description: Review the contract quote, approve USDC custody, and submit the purchase from the verified wallet.
purchase.partial: The contract accepts a partial fill because a cap or wallet limit is reached.
purchase.inactive: Purchases are not active for this round.
purchase.termsRequired: Verify the wallet and accept the current terms before requesting a quote.
purchase.submitted: Purchase submitted. Receipt and network finality are being reconciled.
purchase.approvalConfirmed: USDC approval confirmed. Confirm the purchase transaction next.

history.title: Purchase history
history.description: Wallet receipt, Arbitrum finality, withdrawal, and business finalization remain separate states.
history.empty: No purchases are associated with this wallet yet.

vesting.title: ULIQ Presale Vesting
vesting.description: Each round has its own vesting contract. Claims release only the currently vested amount to this wallet.
vesting.connect: Verify a wallet to load its round-specific vesting positions.
vesting.previewUnavailable: Vesting positions and claims will become available after the reviewed contract configuration is available.
vesting.nothing: Nothing is claimable for this round yet.
vesting.claimSubmitted: Claim submitted. The finalized vesting read will update after reconciliation.

terms.title: ULIQ Presale Terms
terms.description: The dedicated, versioned Presale Terms will be published here after legal approval.
terms.pendingDescription: Until an approved version and text hash are configured, the application keeps all purchase actions disabled.

common.walletRequired: Connect and verify the wallet first.
common.transactionFailed: The transaction failed or was reverted.
